name: 原创全真卷 02（中期校准 · 标准）
note: 结构与真考一致：7 部分 32 题，Q1-30 各 1 分，Q31/Q32 各 15 分，原始分 60，限时 60 分钟。

items.text:
TICKET OFFICE
Buy tickets here or use the machines by Door B. Machines take cards only.
options: You can only buy tickets at the office.
The machines do not take money notes.
items.explain: cards only = 机器只收卡，不收现金纸币。

items.text: Ben, I can't find my maths book. Did I leave it at your house yesterday? If yes, can you bring it to school tomorrow? Carl
items.q: What does Carl want Ben to do?
options: Look for the book and bring it to school.
Buy him a new maths book.
items.explain: 问书在不在他家 + 带来学校。

items.text:
MUSEUM SHOP
Students get 10% off with a school card.
items.explain: with a school card → 出示学生卡打九折。

items.text:
ORCHESTRA PRACTICE
Moved from Tuesday to Thursday this week.
Same time, same room.
items.q: What has changed about the practice?
items.explain: 从周二改到周四——只有日期变了。

items.text: Amy — Gone to the airport to meet Uncle Joe. Dinner is in the fridge. Please feed the fish! Dad
items.explain: feed the fish = 喂鱼；晚饭已在冰箱。

items.text:
CITY PARK
Bikes are welcome on the red path only. Please walk them near the lake.
items.explain: on the red path only；湖边要推行。

profiles.label: A
profiles.title: The Garden
profiles.text: The Garden is open every day from 11 am. You can sit outside under the trees. It is famous for vegetable soup and fresh bread. Children get a free fruit juice at lunch time.

profiles.label: B
profiles.title: Blue Sea
profiles.text: Blue Sea is a fish restaurant by the river. It opens only in the evening. You can watch the boats while you eat. Booking a table is a good idea at weekends because it is small.

profiles.label: C
profiles.title: Pepe's
profiles.text: Pepe's makes the best pizza in town, and you can watch the cooks make it! It is closed on Mondays. There is a big table for birthday parties, and the music is fun and loud.

questions.q: Which restaurant is good for a birthday party?
questions.explain: a big table for birthday parties。

questions.q: Which restaurant is NOT open at lunch time?
questions.explain: Blue Sea opens only in the evening。

questions.q: Where can children get a free drink?
questions.explain: a free fruit juice at lunch time。

questions.q: Where can you see people cooking?
Where should you book at the weekend?
questions.explain: Booking… at weekends because it is small。

questions.q: Which restaurant closes one day every week?

part3.title: A Letter from Camp
part3.passage:
Dear Mum and Dad,
I am having a great time at summer camp! There are twenty children here and I share a room with two boys, Max and Ali. Max snores at night, but I don't mind because I am always tired after the day's activities.
Every morning we swim in the lake before breakfast. The water is cold at first, but you get used to it. In the afternoon we choose an activity. On Monday I tried climbing, and yesterday I learned to cook eggs on a fire! The teacher said mine were the best.
The food here is OK, but not as good as yours, Mum. Please don't tell Dad, but I miss his funny songs too. Only five days until I come home. Can we have noodles on my first night back?
Love, Jin

questions.q: How does Jin feel about Max snoring?
options: It is not a problem for him.
questions.explain: I don't mind because I am always tired。
swim in the lake before breakfast。
yesterday I learned to cook eggs on a fire。

questions.q: What does Jin say about the camp food?
options: It is better than his mum's.
questions.explain: not as good as yours, Mum。

questions.q: What does Jin want to do when he gets home?
questions.explain: Can we have noodles on my first night back?

part4.title: The Violin
part4.passage: The violin is a beautiful (1) ___. It is small and light, so children can (2) ___ it to school easily. To play it, you hold it under your chin and (3) ___ a bow across the strings. Learning the violin is not (4) ___ at first — the sound can be funny! But if you (5) ___ every day, you will get better. Many people say its sound is the closest to a human (6) ___.

gaps.explain: 带去学校 → carry it to school。
拉弓 → pull a bow across the strings。
一开始不容易 → not easy at first。
每天练习 → practise every day。

part5.passage:
Dear Rosa,
Thank you for your letter! You asked about my town, so here (1) ___ some photos. I live in a small town near the mountains. In winter we (2) ___ ski after school — the ski hill is only ten minutes from my house! My favourite place is (3) ___ old bridge over the river. My friends and I fish there (4) ___ summer. Next year my family will move to the city. I am excited but I will miss (5) ___ friends a lot. Please write (6) ___ me again soon!
From, Nick

gaps.shape: here + 复数名词 → 复数等号
gaps.explain: here are some photos：photos 是复数。

gaps.shape: 主语后、动词原形前 → 情态动词
gaps.explain: we can ski 我们能滑雪。

gaps.shape: 空格后是元音开头的名词 → an
gaps.explain: an old bridge：old 元音开头。
in summer 季节是大盒子。

gaps.shape: 空格后是名词 → 物主限定词
gaps.explain: miss my friends 想念我的朋友们。
write to me 给我写信。
